channels.name: Channel A (BP/BM)
channels.purpose: Primary FlexRay channel; differential NRZ at up to 10 Mbit/s.

channels.name: Channel B (BP/BM)
channels.purpose: Second independent channel (redundancy or doubled bandwidth).

channels.name: TxD
channels.purpose: Transmit serial data to the bus driver.

channels.name: TxEN
channels.purpose: Transmit enable; gates the driver to the node's slots.

channels.name: RxD
channels.purpose: Received serial data recovered from the bus.

global_signals.name: Communication cycle
global_signals.purpose: Cluster-wide synchronized periodic schedule (static + dynamic + symbol window + NIT).

global_signals.name: Global time {cycle, macrotick}
global_signals.purpose: Synchronized time base shared by all nodes.

handshake_pairs.name: CHI
handshake_pairs.rule: Controller Host Interface carries configuration and frame data between host and CC.

handshake_pairs.name: TxD/TxEN/RxD
handshake_pairs.rule: Digital data + transmit-enable + receive data between CC and Bus Driver.

handshake_pairs.name: Sync-frame timing
handshake_pairs.rule: Sync frames in the static segment provide the timing references for clock synchronization.

handshake_pairs.name: Coldstart
handshake_pairs.rule: CAS + startup frames establish the schedule; >=2 coldstart nodes must agree.

handshake_pairs.name: Wakeup
handshake_pairs.rule: Wakeup Pattern (WUP) wakes a channel one at a time.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Every node derives the global time {cycle counter, macrotick} from clock synchronization; all slot/segment boundaries are fixed in macroticks identically cluster-wide. The static segment must run (carrying sync frames) for clock synchronization; the NIT applies offset correction.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Transmission in a slot requires: (1) the node synchronized (NORMAL_ACTIVE), (2) the slot/minislot assigned to the node, (3) TxEN gating to the slot. Coldstart (>=2 nodes) must complete before normal frames flow.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Idle/recessive
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: No active driver on the channel; bus rests in the idle differential state.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Data_0 / Data_1
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Active differential NRZ data states forced by the slot owner's driver.

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: Differential NRZ per bit; bytes framed by Byte Start Sequences; no bit stuffing.
ordering_rules.slot_order: Static slots in slot-number order (Frame ID = slot number); dynamic minislots in Frame-ID priority order.
ordering_rules.channel_independence: Channel A and Channel B operate independently; a receiver may use whichever channel carries a valid frame.
ordering_rules.cycle_order: Cycles repeat with the 6-bit cycle counter (0..63).
